Summary: Offer a complete recommendation path without face-photo upload or a registered account.
Description: Offer a complete recommendation path without face-photo upload or a registered account.
Acceptance criteria: Given a visitor declines photo upload and registration, the visitor can enter style, occasion and budget and reach outfit results or a reasoned empty state. [S1]

Summary: Allow account creation and sign-in for cross-session profile and outfit persistence.
Description: Allow account creation and sign-in for cross-session profile and outfit persistence.
Acceptance criteria: A valid registered user can sign in, sign out and retrieve saved preferences; an invalid session cannot access another profile. Proposed scope decision.

Summary: Capture explicit preferences separately from inferred appearance: preferred styles, colors, dis
Description: Capture explicit preferences separately from inferred appearance: preferred styles, colors, disliked colors, sizes and shopping region.
Acceptance criteria: The user can save/edit these fields; a new recommendation request reads the revised values. Unset fields do not block browsing. [S1][S2]

Summary: Capture outfit occasion and user-entered spending constraints for each request.
Description: Capture outfit occasion and user-entered spending constraints for each request.
Acceptance criteria: A request records an occasion and optional budget amount/currency. Editing either triggers a new result set, not an unchanged stale display. [S1]

Summary: Offer consent controls before any facial photograph is transferred or processed.
Description: Offer consent controls before any facial photograph is transferred or processed.
Acceptance criteria: Default is "not consented"; upload/processing does not start without an affirmative action. Consent text explains purpose, storage and deletion. [S1]

Summary: Validate voluntary photograph uploads for supported type, file size and decodability.
Description: Validate voluntary photograph uploads for supported type, file size and decodability.
Acceptance criteria: Invalid or unreadable files are rejected with guidance and without invoking the estimator; JPEG/PNG/WEBP and a proposed 10 MB limit are verified in UI and API tests.

Summary: Display tentative color palette / season suggestions and the uncertainty or quality limitations
Description: Display tentative color palette / season suggestions and the uncertainty or quality limitations of the estimate.
Acceptance criteria: When quality is insufficient the system requests another photo or offers manual colors; no output is presented as a definitive biological category. [S1][S3]

Summary: Allow users to override inferred colors and optional season labels manually.
Description: Allow users to override inferred colors and optional season labels manually.
Acceptance criteria: A user can replace suggested colors and regenerate suggestions; explicit disliked colors are not silently overridden by the photo result. [S1][S3]

Summary: Let users delete their uploaded photograph and associated derived image artefacts.
Description: Let users delete their uploaded photograph and associated derived image artefacts.
Acceptance criteria: A deletion request makes the active image unavailable, returns a deletion confirmation and is covered by a deletion test. Photo-use controls remain accessible. [S1]

Summary: Allow registered users to save or remove outfits and edit their stored profile.
Description: Allow registered users to save or remove outfits and edit their stored profile.
Acceptance criteria: Saved outfits reappear after sign-in; removing a saved outfit does not change the source retailer listing. [S1]

Summary: Accept a structured request and a natural-language shopping prompt.
Description: Accept a structured request and a natural-language shopping prompt.
Acceptance criteria: The user can request, for example, "autumn outfit under 50,000 KZT"; interpreted occasion, currency and budget appear as editable filters. Proposed product direction.

Summary: Retrieve candidates by product type, user size, region, price and availability from the availab
Description: Retrieve candidates by product type, user size, region, price and availability from the available catalog.
Acceptance criteria: Search excludes known out-of-region or unavailable variants when these constraints are requested; missing size/availability is labelled "unknown", never assumed in stock. [S1][S2]

Summary: Maintain a provenance-aware normalized product and offer record.
Description: Maintain a provenance-aware normalized product and offer record.
Acceptance criteria: Each displayed offer has a source retailer, source product identifier, link, image reference/rights, category, price/currency and last-checked timestamp, or an explicit unavailable-value marker. [S2][S3]

Summary: Use only permitted retailer integrations or clearly attributed, reproducible catalog snapshots.
Description: Use only permitted retailer integrations or clearly attributed, reproducible catalog snapshots.
Acceptance criteria: Before ingestion a source record documents method and permission/terms assessment. Demo records are labelled as snapshots; unverified live integrations are not advertised. [S1][S2][S3]

Summary: Keep product variants and retailer-specific offers distinct when normalizing.
Description: Keep product variants and retailer-specific offers distinct when normalizing.
Acceptance criteria: Two sizes/color variants cannot be merged into a single "available" variant if availability differs; duplicate listings have traceable source offers. [S2]

Summary: Make data freshness and availability limitations visible.
Description: Make data freshness and availability limitations visible.
Acceptance criteria: An offer shows as-of time or a clear "data not verified live" notice; expired or invalid links are filtered/flagged during review tests. [S2][S3]

Summary: Support multiple retailer-origin catalog sources through independently replaceable adapters.
Description: Support multiple retailer-origin catalog sources through independently replaceable adapters.
Acceptance criteria: At least two independently attributed, permitted retailer-origin catalogs are targeted for the pilot; when access is unavailable, two source-shaped test fixtures demonstrate the adapter, and the real-data gap is explicitly reported. [S1][S2]

Summary: Provide a transparent state when candidate data are missing, insufficient or unreachable.
Description: Provide a transparent state when candidate data are missing, insufficient or unreachable.
Acceptance criteria: No results screen states which constraint caused zero valid matches where determinable, suggests changing filters and does not fabricate products. [S1][S3]

Summary: Compose complete outfits from compatible categories instead of isolated items only.
Description: Compose complete outfits from compatible categories instead of isolated items only.
Acceptance criteria: A returned outfit identifies category roles and linked candidate products; incompatible/incomplete proposals are excluded or visibly tagged as partial. [S1][S3]

Summary: Separate initial retrieval, outfit compatibility assessment and individualized ranking.
Description: Separate initial retrieval, outfit compatibility assessment and individualized ranking.
Acceptance criteria: Three stages can be invoked/benchmarked independently using the same catalog snapshot; system logs model/snapshot versions for evaluation. [S2][S3]

Summary: Apply explicit exclusions and hard feasibility constraints before final display.
Description: Apply explicit exclusions and hard feasibility constraints before final display.
Acceptance criteria: A test item with a forbidden size, unavailable status, excluded color or exceeded strict budget never appears in results labelled as eligible. [S1][S2]

Summary: Show the price per item and calculated sum of listed item prices for each recommended outfit.
Description: Show the price per item and calculated sum of listed item prices for each recommended outfit.
Acceptance criteria: The displayed subtotal is the arithmetic sum of exactly the shown offers in one selected currency, including a reproducible calculation example. [S1][S2]

Summary: Differentiate product subtotal from delivery charges, tax and currency conversion assumptions.
Description: Differentiate product subtotal from delivery charges, tax and currency conversion assumptions.
Acceptance criteria: If shipping/tax is unavailable, the UI states "not included / unknown" and does not call the subtotal a full checkout total; missing FX data never produce guessed conversions. [S2]

Summary: In strict-budget mode, ensure that the displayed item subtotal does not exceed the declared lim
Description: In strict-budget mode, ensure that the displayed item subtotal does not exceed the declared limit.
Acceptance criteria: For every returned eligible outfit: sum(listed prices) ≤ max budget. A flexible-range mode is a research option to validate with users. [S1][S2]

Summary: Display clear reasons for each recommendation.
Description: Display clear reasons for each recommendation.
Acceptance criteria: For each outfit, at least two applicable reasons or trade-offs are shown (e.g., selected style, colors, occasion, price), without claiming color-type certainty. [S1][S3]

Summary: Offer directly attributable product links and retailer alternatives when catalog choices exist.
Description: Offer directly attributable product links and retailer alternatives when catalog choices exist.
Acceptance criteria: Selecting an offer opens its recorded retailer URL; where two valid alternatives exist, users can compare retailer, price, size and timestamp side by side. [S1][S2]

Summary: Record explicit likes/dislikes and outfit ratings without implying an already trained adaptive
Description: Record explicit likes/dislikes and outfit ratings without implying an already trained adaptive model.
Acceptance criteria: User feedback persists only with appropriate account/consent state; tests compare recommendations with/without feedback before adaptive ranking is promoted. [S1][S3]

Summary: Avoid claim of exact physical fit, body measurements or guaranteed color suitability.
Description: Avoid claim of exact physical fit, body measurements or guaranteed color suitability.
Acceptance criteria: User-facing explanations distinguish user-selected size from predicted body fit and label seasonal palette as a styling suggestion. [S1][S3]

Summary: Provide a restricted admin function to ingest and inspect catalog quality.
Description: Provide a restricted admin function to ingest and inspect catalog quality.
Acceptance criteria: Only authorized admins can load a snapshot, view rejected records and verify source mappings; unauthenticated requests are denied. [S2]

Summary: Keep a versioned catalog snapshot for reproducible tests and comparisons.
Description: Keep a versioned catalog snapshot for reproducible tests and comparisons.
Acceptance criteria: Each recommendation evaluation can identify the data snapshot ID and timestamp; re-running a deterministic baseline on the same inputs produces the same eligible candidate set. [S2][S3]

Summary: Provide a user-facing explanation of photo handling and data deletion.
Description: Provide a user-facing explanation of photo handling and data deletion.
Acceptance criteria: A privacy view describes whether photo bytes are retained, who can access them and how to remove them; document wording matches verified system behavior. [S1]

Summary: Allow account-data export and deletion if persistent accounts are implemented.
Description: Allow account-data export and deletion if persistent accounts are implemented.
Acceptance criteria: Authenticated users can request removal of profile, saved looks and feedback; deletion and any unavoidable retention exceptions are auditable and documented.

Summary: Ensure retailer checkout and payment take place outside ANTHEIA.
Description: Ensure retailer checkout and payment take place outside ANTHEIA.
Acceptance criteria: ANTHEIA shows outbound product links and no internal payment form or purchase status; the user is informed that merchant terms apply. Proposed scope decision.

Summary: Provide clearly marked demonstration behavior when a live feed is unavailable.
Description: Provide clearly marked demonstration behavior when a live feed is unavailable.
Acceptance criteria: Demo data carry "sample / as-of" markers; connector failures do not silently fall back to invented current prices. [S1][S2]

Summary: Performance
Description: On a defined pilot snapshot of up to 5,000 offers, target p95 ≤ 3 seconds for a recommendation request excluding image processing.
Acceptance criteria: Replay ≥100 requests; record machine, dataset, model and p50/p95. Proposed target; not a measured result.

Summary: Image turnaround
Description: For an accepted ≤3 MB sample photo, target p95 ≤ 8 seconds on stated test hardware.
Acceptance criteria: Run ≥30 representative images; report failures and quality warnings. Target subject to baseline feasibility.

Summary: Data correctness
Description: All eligible strict-budget outfits satisfy their item subtotal cap; zero false "in stock" assertions for missing availability in fixture tests.
Acceptance criteria: Automated property-based checks on boundary values and unknown variants; target 100% for hard constraints.

Summary: Transport security
Description: Production deployment shall use HTTPS/TLS; credentials and authorization tokens shall not be logged.
Acceptance criteria: Inspect deployed endpoints, capture HTTP redirect behavior and audit masked log samples.

Summary: Access control
Description: Profile reads/edits and admin catalog actions shall enforce authorization at the server.
Acceptance criteria: Cross-account IDOR and unauthorized admin action tests all reject access.

Summary: Photo privacy
Description: Original photos shall be optional, private and inaccessible to unauthorized roles; active deletion removes retrievable photo bytes.
Acceptance criteria: Consent-off test, access-control test and deletion verification on active storage. Backup exceptions require documented policy.

Summary: Data minimization
Description: Capture only data necessary for recommendations; do not infer or store identity, health, ethnicity or body measures from appearance.
Acceptance criteria: Review stored schema, response payloads and logs for prohibited attributes.

Summary: Explainability
Description: Every seasonal suggestion shall expose uncertainty/quality caveats; every ranked outfit shall show plain-language reasons.
Acceptance criteria: UI inspection of valid/poor-light photos and recommendation samples.

Summary: Reproducibility
Description: Keep immutable experiment configuration: catalog version, model version, code commit, fixed seed where applicable.
Acceptance criteria: Independent rerun reconstructs same eligible candidates and reports measured ranking differences.

Summary: Data freshness
Description: Every retailer-origin offer shall retain the source update/as-of metadata and clearly distinguish a live offer from a snapshot.
Acceptance criteria: Spot-check catalog records and visual displays; unknown recency stays unknown.

Summary: Reliability
Description: External source failure or image failure shall not break manual-preference recommendations when a valid cached snapshot exists.
Acceptance criteria: Disable source/image dependency in tests; display clear degraded-mode status.

Summary: Accessibility
Description: Target WCAG 2.2 AA for implemented primary screens, including keyboard navigation, meaningful labels and 4.5:1 normal-text contrast.
Acceptance criteria: Keyboard-only walkthrough, automated accessibility checks and manual audit on core flow.

Summary: Responsive design
Description: Support accessible layouts on 375px mobile, 768px tablet and 1440px desktop viewports without horizontal page overflow.
Acceptance criteria: Capture/screenshots and complete the core journey at each width.

Summary: Maintainability
Description: Keep image estimation, retrieval, ranking, budget validation and catalog adapters as independently testable modules.
Acceptance criteria: Change one catalog adapter or ranking policy without altering image module contracts; test relevant interfaces.

Summary: Testing quality
Description: Automated tests cover all mandatory hard filters, price computation, consent and deletion paths.
Acceptance criteria: CI must pass identified acceptance cases and core privacy / price regression tests before release.

Summary: Logging
Description: Logs shall avoid photo bytes, secret keys and full personal profiles; include correlation ID and component errors.
Acceptance criteria: Search redacted test logs for sensitive samples; verify failure traces by correlation ID.

Summary: Catalog compliance
Description: Use documented approved access methods; preserve attribution and required usage constraints for product images.
Acceptance criteria: Maintain a per-source approval / provenance register before public display.

Summary: Fairness and limitations
Description: Report photo-model error by lighting/quality and relevant consented user-group slices when ethically collected; avoid universal suitability claims.
Acceptance criteria: Evaluation includes perturbation/repeat-photo tests and qualitative limitations section.
